reason: Cross-sectional study directly compares DNA methylation (DMRs at RNF39, VTRNA2-1/MIR886, AURKC, IRF6) in blood of children with intellectual disability versus matched controls, explored as a pain biomarker.
Multinational retrospective cohort classifies infant medulloblastoma by DNA methylation array-based molecular grouping and links MBGroup3/4 subtypes to treatment approach and survival outcomes.
Prospective multi-centre trial directly measures cfDNA methylation at RNF135/CHFR/PAX5 to build a diagnostic liquid biopsy for early liver cancer detection in high-risk patients.
Training/validation cohorts measure cfDNA 5-hydroxymethylcytosine (a DNA methylation-derived mark) to build a diagnostic/prognostic signature for early hepatocellular carcinoma detection.

Compares DNAm-based epigenetic aging (IEAA, GrimAge, PhenoAge) between SGM and cisgender-straight CARDIA participants but does not tie the marker to a modifiable exposure or a clinical/public-health decision, only a disparity comparison.

850K methylation array comparison across normal, intestinal metaplasia, IEN and gastric cardia cancer tissue identifies EDNRB/SALL1 hypermethylation as diagnostic biomarkers, validated by immunohistochemistry.
Tumor tissue from the RTOG-0539 trial cohort is profiled by DNA methylation array and linked to radiotherapy response and recurrence risk in meningioma patients.
Biological age acceleration is derived from clinical/metabolic biomarkers (KDM, Light-BioAgeAccel) with no DNA methylation or other epigenetic assay reported.
Paired pre/post-surgical blood samples in hip-fracture patients undergo genome-wide DNA methylation and enrichment analysis to identify postoperative delirium biomarkers.
Retrospective comparison of decitabine dosing schedules with venetoclax reports remission and survival outcomes but does not measure any DNA methylation or other epigenetic mark in patients.
Pilot cohort of umbilical cord blood performs parallel DNA methylation profiling comparing infants who developed BPD/chorioamnionitis to unaffected preterm/term infants.
ARID1A somatic mutation status (not DNA methylation or another epigenetic mark) is the variable analyzed against TCGA/ICGC survival and immune infiltration data.
Cross-sectional study measures placental DNA methylation (EPIC BeadChip) in neonates and relates it to maternal fluoride exposure and low kidney volume.
Genome-wide DNA methylation episignature is developed and validated against 854 controls to classify pathogenic KMT2D variants causing Kabuki syndrome, an eligible diagnostic-classifier design.
LASI-DAD cohort derives seven DNA methylation-based epigenetic clocks and relates them to blood neurodegeneration biomarkers as a monitoring tool in older Indian adults.
A 14-week supervised exercise intervention measures Illumina EPIC DNA methylation and intrinsic epigenetic age acceleration before and after training in women with differing aerobic fitness.
MRI radiomics model predicts cribriform prostate cancer growth from imaging features; no DNA methylation, histone mark, or other epigenetic measurement is involved.

Retrospective series of 422 individuals undergoing constitutional MLH1 promoter methylation testing characterizes clinical phenotype and germline variants without a comparator group, matching the case-series exclusion.
Serum folic acid concentration is compared between children with and without atopic disease; DNA methylation is discussed as background but never assayed.
Targeted NGS somatic mutation profiling of Pakistani AML patients reports DNMT3A gene mutation frequency, not a measured DNA methylation mark.
EZH2/LSD1 expression is correlated with TCGA-LIHC survival and probed mechanistically by ChIP-seq in HCC cell lines, but no epigenetic mark is measured in human participants.
Cross-sectional registry analysis of blood-pressure control factors in young Malaysian adults involves no epigenetic marker of any kind.
Long-read Nanopore genome-wide DNA methylation profiling in blood compares children with obesity to matched controls to identify obesity-associated CpG regions.

Phase 1 vaccine trial in MGMT-unmethylated glioblastoma reports vaccine safety/immunogenicity; MGMT methylation only defines the enrolled population rather than being related to an exposure or decision under study.
XGBoost model predicts NHANES-derived KDM/PhenoAge biological aging from dietary antioxidant intake using clinical biomarkers, with no DNA methylation or other epigenetic assay.
TCGA melanoma cohort and two validation cohorts use tumor DNA methylation locus-pair ordering to build a validated prognostic biomarker model (CM-LP11).
Phenotypic age here is a clinical-biomarker composite mediating a diet-muscular dystrophy association; no DNA methylation or epigenetic assay is reported.
Prospective study directly measures RASSF1A and SHOX2 methylation in intraoperative pleural lavage fluid and links it to NSCLC recurrence risk.
PGC promoter DNA methylation is measured in Pakistani gastric adenocarcinoma tissue and compared with public datasets to link hypermethylation to gene silencing and prognosis.
Whole-exome sequencing identifies CAMSAP1 genetic variants causing sperm head defects; no DNA methylation, histone modification, or chromatin-state assay is performed in humans.

Citrullinated histone H3 (CitH3) is measured in SFTS patient plasma as a circulating NETosis biomarker, which the instrument specifically classifies as a protein assay rather than a chromatin-state measurement.
Prospective cohort of ICI-treated cancer patients profiles peripheral blood DNA methylation (EPIC array) at baseline and longitudinally to predict immunotherapy response.
cfDNA methylation markers are identified from TCGA and an in-house cohort and validated as a 30-marker classifier to distinguish malignant from benign pulmonary nodules.

WSTF-GLYCTK regulatory link in colorectal cancer is inferred through summary-data-based Mendelian randomization using GWAS/eQTL/mQTL summary statistics rather than individual-level methylation measurement.
Retrospective cohort of metastatic small-intestinal NET measures phosphohistone H3 (a histone modification) by immunohistochemistry and relates it to cancer-specific survival and treatment response.
Prospective birth-cohort study measures placental genome-wide DNA methylation and relates specific CpGs to prenatal bisphenol exposure and child myopia risk.
The mCAS aging-clock study explicitly describes plasma protein clocks and clinical/physiological data without ever mentioning DNA methylation or another epigenetic assay.
Twelve-cohort epigenome-wide association study of blood DNA methylation identifies differentially methylated CpGs/regions distinguishing bipolar disorder cases from controls.
PRAME promoter methylation is measured in TCGA and an independent HCC cohort (MethylTarget assay) and linked to survival and metastasis.
NHANES analysis derives epigenetic age acceleration from DNA methylation clocks and links it to early-life BMI and physical activity as modifiable exposures.
KDM-BA and PhenoAge acceleration are computed from clinical biomarkers (not DNA methylation) and tested for association with incident CKD in diabetes cohorts.
WT1 mRNA level, not any DNA methylation or histone mark, is the biomarker monitored for AML treatment response.
Retrospective study of chidamide (an HDAC inhibitor drug) maintenance therapy outcomes in T-ALL/T-LBL reports no epigenetic marker measurement, only survival and adverse-event data.
The abstract describes a multianalyte HelioLiver Dx blood test for HCC detection but never states whether DNA methylation or any other epigenetic mark is among the analytes measured.

DNA methylation classification is applied only as an exploratory comparator in a small subset of pituitary tumors alongside the primary H&E image-based AI classifier, leaving its role and design unclear.
Retrospective audit of febrile-infant management and guideline adherence across London hospitals involves no epigenetic marker.
Thirteen ovarian CNS-type tumors are retrospectively characterized by methylation-based classification as a case series without a comparison group.
Case-control comparison of GBM patients versus healthy controls quantifies methylated circulating cell-free DNA alongside MPO and links it to diagnostic and mortality-risk value.

Therapeutic targets in urological cancers are nominated through transcriptome-wide and summary-data Mendelian randomization using eQTLGen/GoDMC mQTL summary statistics, not measured methylation in patients.
Reduced-representation bisulfite sequencing identifies tumor-specific DMRs validated into a real-time PCR assay (GasAiQ) for gastric cancer screening and recurrence-risk stratification.
PhenoAgeAccel, KDMAccel and GOLD BioAgeDiff are calculated from UK Biobank clinical biomarkers, with no DNA methylation assay described, for diabetic retinopathy risk.

Cross-sectional Baltimore cohort study measures blood DNA methylation to derive four epigenetic clocks and relates actigraphy-based circadian rhythm metrics, a modifiable behavior, to epigenetic age acceleration.
Case-control study directly measures methylated SEPT9 in peripheral blood by droplet digital PCR for non-invasive colorectal cancer diagnosis.
Longitudinal EWAS of blood DNA methylation in MESA, replicated in Framingham, identifies age-varying CpGs associated with blood pressure, a modifiable cardiovascular risk factor.
This is a five-year cohort study protocol describing planned multi-omics profiling (including DNA methylation) of postpartum women, with no results yet reported.
The vascular age model is built from routine physical-examination biomarkers via the Klemera-Doubal method, not from DNA methylation or any epigenetic assay.
Illumina EPIC array profiling of whole blood DNA methylation in women with SLE identifies DMRs (e.g., REST motif) associated with SLEDAI-2K disease activity.
KMT2A-rearranged/RAS-mutant leukemia study evaluates menin and MEK inhibitor combination therapy based on genetic mutations, not a measured epigenetic mark.

Causal links between noise-associated CpGs and cardiovascular disease are estimated via two-sample Mendelian randomization using published EWAS/mQTL and GWAS summary statistics, not measured methylation in participants.
Serum prolactin and SOX4-PRL-c-MYC signaling in retroperitoneal sarcoma are examined via ELISA, RNA-seq and ChIP-qPCR in cell lines, without a human epigenetic-marker measurement.
Salivary proteomics identifies drug-repurposing candidates for periodontitis (including HDAC inhibitors as candidate drugs), but no epigenetic marker itself is measured.
The BHARAT study description is a cross-sectional cohort protocol outlining planned multi-omics (including epigenomic) data collection in India, with future-tense aims and no reported findings.

Citrullinated histone H3 (Cit-H3) is measured as a circulating NETosis protein biomarker for postoperative frailty risk in ovarian cancer, which the instrument treats as a protein assay, not a chromatin-state measurement.
Bisulfite pyrosequencing directly measures BRCA1 promoter methylation in matched tumor/normal tissue from African women with breast cancer and links it to hormone-receptor subtype.
Differential methylation analysis and a diagnostic model built from CpG sites are validated in an independent cohort to identify osteoarthritis-associated methylation biomarkers.
ZDHHC5/PPT1 links to osteoporosis are established via two-sample and summary-data-based Mendelian randomization using FinnGen GWAS and GoDMC methylation QTL summary statistics.
Prospective diagnostic study measures RASSF1A/SHOX2 methylation in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid and builds a multimodal model for malignant lung lesion detection.
Health and Retirement Study cohort computes an epigenetic-g DNA methylation score and relates it to baseline cognition and cognitive change in a nationally representative sample.

Real-world chidamide (HDAC inhibitor) plus chemotherapy outcomes in PTCL are reported alongside gene mutation frequencies (TET2, DNMT3A), but no DNA methylation or other epigenetic mark is directly assayed.
Plasma citrullinated histone H3 is measured as a NETosis biomarker across ischemic stroke subtypes, matching the instrument's circulating-histone-protein exclusion.
Prognostic SNPs in NK-cell-related genes for gastric cancer are annotated using public methylation-QTL databases, but methylation itself is not measured in the study cohort.
Elastic-net regression on a population cohort develops MethylCog, a 29-CpG DNA methylation score, and validates it against cognitive test performance and MCI discrimination.
Nested case-control study measures blood ACTB gene methylation by mass spectrometry and relates hypermethylation to future coronary heart disease risk.
KdmAge, PhenoAge and HD Age biological-aging measures in UK Biobank are derived from clinical biomarkers, not DNA methylation, and related to heart disease incidence.

Antibiotic-associated gut aging is assessed via a composite biological-age measure in a human cross-sectional analysis, with the epigenetic mechanism explored only in zebrafish/cell models, not in the human data.
Feasibility cluster-randomized trial compares an Ayurvedic clinical guideline to usual care for type 2 diabetes; no epigenetic marker is measured.
Prospective mother-infant cohort measures placental DNA methylation (EPIC v2.0) and tests moderation by prenatal metal-mixture exposure of the CRH-to-neurobehavior pathway.
Biological age in this NHANES infertility analysis is estimated from CRP and glycemic indices, not from any DNA methylation or epigenetic assay.
NHANES cohort computes DNA methylation-based epigenetic clocks (HorvathAge, HannumAge, PhenoAge, GrimAge) and tests their mediation of glucose-related allostatic load's effect on mortality.
Endoplasmic-reticulum-stress gene links to 18 cancers are established via Mendelian randomization and colocalization using GWAS/eQTL/mQTL summary statistics, not individually measured methylation.
Genome-wide blood DNA methylation is measured in Bangladeshi adults with variable arsenic exposure to build and validate a DNAm-based arsenic-exposure biomarker.
Barcelona birth cohort study performs an EWAS of placental DNA methylation (Illumina EPIC) linked to maternal meal-timing (chrono-nutrition) behavior during pregnancy.
Cross-sectional RODAM study measures DNA methylation clocks (Horvath, Hannum, PhenoAge, GrimAge) in Ghanaian adults and relates specific food-group intake to epigenetic age acceleration.

Cerebral venous thrombosis therapy study measures NLRP3, elastase, MPO and citrullinated histone H3 in CSF/serum as inflammatory markers, none of which constitute a chromatin-state or DNA methylation assay.
Prospective pre/post-surgical study measures ELOVL2 promoter methylation by droplet digital PCR in stage I lung cancer patients as a marker of epigenetic age reversal after resection.
Case-control EWAS of Brazilian men measures blood DNA methylation (EPIC v2.0) and identifies DMRs distinguishing alcohol use disorder patients from controls.
Retrospective multicenter study measures tumor DNA methylation subtypes (demethylated to CIMP) in pleural mesothelioma and links them to immune checkpoint inhibitor response and survival.

Cross-sectional feasibility study measures DNA methylation-based epigenetic clocks (DNAmAge, DNAmPhenoAge, DNAmAgeHannum) and correlates them with a composite motor-function score in community-dwelling adults.
A factorial dietary RCT measures Klemera-Doubal biological age from clinical biomarkers, not DNA methylation, before and after a 4-week diet intervention.
A case series of 101 Beckwith-Wiedemann spectrum patients characterizes multilocus methylation disturbance prevalence by microarray without a comparison group.
Case-control training and validation cohorts measure a five-gene DNA methylation panel (ELMO1, FGF12, NPY, SEPTIN9, ZNF671) in blood for gastric cancer screening.
UK Biobank cross-sectional analysis links takeaway-food consumption to PhenoAge/KDM biological age derived from clinical biomarkers, with no DNA methylation assay reported.
Nine matched meningioma-sarcoma tumor pairs are characterized by DNA methylation profiling as a molecular case series without a comparison group.
Shanghai birth cohort measures placental DNA methylation (EPIC array) in a subsample and relates specific CpGs to prenatal PFAS exposure and small-vulnerable-newborn outcomes.
Randomized placebo-controlled gluten-challenge trial of the TG2 inhibitor ZED1227 in celiac disease includes whole-blood DNA methylation profiling among the measured multi-omic outcomes.

Illumina EPIC methylation profiling directly measured in Ghanaian and Nigerian cohorts identifies CpGs subsequently tested by Mendelian randomization and longitudinal follow-up for causal links to type 2 diabetes.
Pooled case-control studies directly assess CpG island methylator phenotype (CIMP) status in colorectal tumors and test its association with alcohol consumption alongside MSI/BRAF/KRAS subtypes.
Case-control study measures blood AHRR (cg05575921) DNA methylation and combines it with heavy-metal exposure and smoking history for urothelial carcinoma risk stratification.
NHANES longitudinal analysis mediates a dietary-gut-microbiota-index/mortality association through PhenoAge/KDMAge/HD biological age from clinical biomarkers, not DNA methylation.
Micronucleus scoring on breast cytology smears assesses chromosomal instability, not DNA methylation, histone modification, or another eligible epigenetic marker.
